description: This file defines the EntityCache class, which manages caching of entity data using primary keys and entity conditions within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityCache
classes.description: A cache management class for entity data, supporting get, put, and remove operations with cache invalidation.

methods.name: EntityCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with a delegator name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue from the cache based on its primary key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a GenericValue to the cache, using its primary key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a GenericValue to the cache with a specified primary key, respecting the never-cache setting.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes entries from the cache that match a given entity condition.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific GenericValue from the cache based on its primary key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a GenericValue from the cache based on the provided primary key.
